title.narrative: Driving Corporate Climate Action in Mauritius: Supporting Mauritian companies in setting up climate transition plans aligned with both global climate standards and a new Mauritius Corporate NDC

description.narrative: This project supports Mauritian companies in developing climate transition plans aligned with global climate standards and Mauritiusâ€™ Corporate NDC. It includes the development of sectoral and cross-sectoral climate transition plan toolkits, guidance and training resources; a CGI website for downloading resources; qualitative and quantitative surveys; an online platform for Corporate NDP Pledges; the establishment of a Mauritius Transition Plan Taskforce to foster dialogue and coordinated action; roundtable discussions and other key events; capacity-building sessions for women climate leaders; communication and dissemination activities; and dedicated project staffing to coordinate delivery and the growth and visibility of CGI Mauritius.

sector.narrative: Business-facing climate transition support for Mauritian companies through toolkits, training, platform resources and related engagement mechanisms.
